title: Compatibility adapter + migration kit for streaming, tool-calls, and structured outputs
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Scope: Implement a compatibility adapter and a migration kit to smooth deprecation of legacy behavior flags and minimize regressions for streaming, function/tool calling, and structured output changes across API versions.

Goals:
- Provide a runtime 'compat adapter' that accepts legacy request shapes (old flags, legacy streaming markers, previous tool-call payloads) and translates them to the new v2 behavior without performance regressions for common paths.
- Ship a set of automated back-compat tests (input->golden output snapshots + token-level fuzz probes) that run against both hosted and dedicated modes.
- Publish a migration kit for customers and SDKs: clear mapping of deprecated flags, recommended replacements, behavioral diffs, and automated refactor scripts for common SDK patterns.
- Introduce short-lived opt-in 'compat-mode' config for tenants to allow gradual rollout and A/B testing before turning strict v2 behavior on.

Non-goals: removing legacy server support in this ticket; work to run the adapter in Private customer's air-gapped clusters is tracked separately.

Design notes and constraints:
- The adapter must be pluggable at the front of request routing (policy layer) so we can route non-upgraded tenants to adapter+new runtime while upgraded tenants call new runtime directly.
- Latency budget: adapter path should add <=6ms p50 on top of existing routing in hosted steady-state. If above threshold we fallback to lightweight header-based compatibility routing.
- Testing: use a combination of deterministic replay (recorded user sessions) and corpus-based fuzzing for streaming chunk boundaries, tool-call partial transcripts, and structured JSON schema drift.
- Metrics: add compatibility-translate-duration_ms, translation-failure_count, migration-probe-regressions. These will feed the rollout gate for Canary->Gradual rollout.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Compat adapter implemented and exercised in unit & integration tests.
2) Migration kit docs published (internal + public migration guide draft).
3) Cross-cutting backcompat test harness (CI job) that compares new runtime outputs with legacy behavior under behavior-flag permutations.
4) Canary schedule defined and first canary executed in staging with <0.5% semantic-regression rate on our regression prompts set.

Out-of-scope items (follow-ups):
- SDK major-version bumps and packaging (PM track).
- Heavyweight Private deployment automation for adapter (ENG-28010).
